heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy with the chance of drizzle or a shower. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, some mid 30s far north. Winds becoming northwest 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Clouds decreasing in the morning, variable in the afternoon. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s north, and mid 50s to around 60 in the south. North to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the morning.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Becoming cloudy. Showers likely west of the Greens, a rising chance east. Lows in the mid to upper 30s, some lower 30s northeast. Winds becoming east to southeast a 5 to 10 mph.
